claims.gist: A typical application may pull in hundreds or thousands of open-source packages
Route installs through an approved internal proxy, not direct public registry pulls
Block packages below a minimum age or with few downloads until reviewed
Pin exact versions and commit lockfiles to prevent silent upgrades
Disable install-time scripts by default, allowing them only for reviewed packages
Scan for known malicious packages, not only known vulnerabilities
SBOMs, proxy routing and lockfile pinning are the fastest wins

thesis: Reduce open-source supply chain risk: know dependencies, gate registries, vet packages, pin versions and limit install scripts.
